name: KPI Card
description: Single headline figure with optional comparison, threshold band and trend indicator.

generation.purpose: Show one important number prominently, optionally with how it compares to a previous period and whether it is within acceptable bounds.
generation.whenToUse: For a single aggregated value the user needs to read at a glance — counts, totals, rates, ages. Use several side by side to form a KPI row at the top of an operational dashboard.
generation.whenNotToUse: Do not use for more than one value, for a breakdown by any dimension, or for a time series. Use analytics.chart for anything with a dimension.

showThresholdBand.description: Render the measure's threshold bands as emphasis on the value. Requires either the measure's defaultThresholds or a thresholds override on the value binding.

showTrendArrow.description: Show direction of change against the comparison binding. Direction of goodness comes from the measure's higherIsBetter, so the component does not need to be told which way is good.

activated.label: Card activated
activated.description: Emitted when the user clicks or presses Enter on the card. Typically mapped to a drill-down or a navigate action.

retryRequested.label: Retry requested
retryRequested.description: Emitted when the user activates Retry in the error state.

xs.note: Comparison and sparkline are suppressed below sm.

accessibility.keyboardContract: Focusable when an activation action is bound; Enter and Space activate. Not focusable otherwise, so a static card does not add a meaningless tab stop.
accessibility.notes: Threshold state is conveyed by an icon and text as well as emphasis colour. The value is exposed to assistive technology with its formatted text and its unit.
